title: 낯선 라벨
suno_analysis_sp: K-Indie folk ballad. Fingerpicked acoustic guitar plays a steady eighth-note pattern with occasional hammer-ons. A warm, melodic electric bass follows the root notes with subtle slides. Soft, dry percussion consists of a shaker and a muted kick drum on beats 1 and 3. Male vocals are delivered in a breathy, intimate baritone register with minimal vibrato. The arrangement is sparse, focusing on the interplay between the acoustic guitar and the vocal melody. Key of G Major. Tempo is 78 BPM. 4/4 time signature.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[fingerpicked acoustic guitar]

[Verse 1]
[breathy male vocals]
해낼 수 없는 라벨 [shaker enters]
장바구니에 담아
아무거나 골라서 다시 내려놓았어 [bass enters]

[Verse 2]
낯선 글자 사이로
익숙한 봉지 하나
라면이었거든 그거라는 채로 한참을 서 있었어

[Chorus]
엄마가 그려준 [muted kick drum enters]
그 맛은 여기 없어
숟가락 하나로 [acoustic guitar continues arpeggio]
